import re
import unicodedata
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import date, datetime, timezone

MAX_NESTING_DEPTH = 6
FORBIDDEN_KEYS = frozenset({'cvv', 'cvc', 'security_code'})
PAN_PATTERN = re.compile(r'[0-9]{13,19}')
EXPIRY_PATTERN = re.compile(r'(0[1-9]|1[0-2])/([0-9]{2}|[0-9]{4})')
COUNTRY_PATTERN = re.compile(r'[A-Z]{2}')
EXPIRY_MAX_YEARS_AHEAD = 15
METADATA_MAX_KEYS = 20
METADATA_MAX_VALUE_LENGTH = 256
METADATA_ALLOWED_CONTROLS = frozenset('\t\n')
TTL_MIN_SECONDS = 60
TTL_MAX_SECONDS = 86400


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ValidationError:
    path: str
    code: str
    message: str


@dataclass
class ValidationResult:
    errors: list[ValidationError] = field(default_factory=list)

    @property
    def ok(self) -> bool:
        return not self.errors


def validate_request(payload: dict) -> ValidationResult:
    errors: list[ValidationError] = []
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        _add(errors, '', 'INVALID_TYPE', 'payload must be an object')
        return ValidationResult(errors)
    _scan_structure(payload, 1, '', errors)
    today = datetime.now(timezone.utc).date()
    _validate_card(payload, today, errors)
    _validate_metadata(payload, errors)
    _validate_token_policy(payload, errors)
    return ValidationResult(errors)


def _add(errors: list[ValidationError], path: str, code: str, message: str) -> None:
    errors.append(ValidationError(path, code, message))


def _join(path: str, key: object) -> str:
    return f'{path}.{key}' if path else str(key)


def _has_control(value: str, allowed: frozenset[str] = frozenset()) -> bool:
    return any(unicodedata.category(c) == 'Cc' and c not in allowed for c in value)


def _is_forbidden_key(key: object) -> bool:
    if not isinstance(key, str):
        return False
    normalized = unicodedata.normalize('NFC', key).strip().lower().replace('-', '_').replace(' ', '_')
    return normalized in FORBIDDEN_KEYS


def _scan_structure(node: object, depth: int, path: str, errors: list[ValidationError]) -> None:
    if not isinstance(node, (dict, list)):
        return
    if depth > MAX_NESTING_DEPTH:
        _add(errors, path, 'NESTING_TOO_DEEP', f'payload nesting exceeds {MAX_NESTING_DEPTH} levels')
        return
    if isinstance(node, dict):
        for key, value in node.items():
            child = _join(path, key)
            if _is_forbidden_key(key):
                _add(errors, child, 'CVV_NOT_ALLOWED', 'card security code must not be included in the payload')
            else:
                _scan_structure(value, depth + 1, child, errors)
    else:
        for index, item in enumerate(node):
            _scan_structure(item, depth + 1, f'{path}[{index}]', errors)


def _required_str(container: dict, key: str, path: str, errors: list[ValidationError]) -> str | None:
    value = container.get(key)
    if value is None:
        _add(errors, path, 'MISSING', f'{path} is required')
        return None
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        _add(errors, path, 'INVALID_TYPE', f'{path} must be a string')
        return None
    value = unicodedata.normalize('NFC', value)
    if not value.strip():
        _add(errors, path, 'EMPTY', f'{path} must not be empty')
        return None
    if _has_control(value):
        _add(errors, path, 'CONTROL_CHARACTER', f'{path} contains control characters')
        return None
    return value


def _required_dict(container: dict, key: str, path: str, errors: list[ValidationError]) -> dict | None:
    value = container.get(key)
    if value is None:
        _add(errors, path, 'MISSING', f'{path} is required')
        return None
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        _add(errors, path, 'INVALID_TYPE', f'{path} must be an object')
        return None
    return value


def _validate_card(payload: dict, today: date, errors: list[ValidationError]) -> None:
    card = _required_dict(payload, 'card', 'card', errors)
    if card is None:
        return
    _validate_pan(card, errors)
    _validate_expiry(card, today, errors)
    _validate_billing(card, errors)


def _validate_pan(card: dict, errors: list[ValidationError]) -> None:
    pan = _required_str(card, 'pan', 'card.pan', errors)
    if pan is None:
        return
    digits = re.sub(r'[ -]', '', pan)
    if PAN_PATTERN.fullmatch(digits) is None:
        _add(errors, 'card.pan', 'PAN_INVALID', 'card.pan must be 13-19 digits (spaces and hyphens allowed)')
        return
    if not _luhn_valid(digits):
        _add(errors, 'card.pan', 'PAN_LUHN_FAILED', f'card.pan ending in {digits[-4:]} failed the Luhn check')


def _luhn_valid(digits: str) -> bool:
    total = 0
    for index, char in enumerate(reversed(digits)):
        value = int(char)
        if index % 2 == 1:
            value *= 2
            if value > 9:
                value -= 9
        total += value
    return total % 10 == 0


def _validate_expiry(card: dict, today: date, errors: list[ValidationError]) -> None:
    expiry = _required_str(card, 'expiry', 'card.expiry', errors)
    if expiry is None:
        return
    match = EXPIRY_PATTERN.fullmatch(expiry)
    if match is None:
        _add(errors, 'card.expiry', 'EXPIRY_INVALID', 'card.expiry must be MM/YY or MM/YYYY')
        return
    month = int(match.group(1))
    year_text = match.group(2)
    year = int(year_text) if len(year_text) == 4 else 2000 + int(year_text)
    if (year, month) < (today.year, today.month):
        _add(errors, 'card.expiry', 'EXPIRY_PAST', 'card.expiry is in the past')
    elif (year, month) > (today.year + EXPIRY_MAX_YEARS_AHEAD, today.month):
        _add(errors, 'card.expiry', 'EXPIRY_TOO_FAR', f'card.expiry is more than {EXPIRY_MAX_YEARS_AHEAD} years ahead')


def _validate_billing(card: dict, errors: list[ValidationError]) -> None:
    billing = _required_dict(card, 'billing', 'card.billing', errors)
    if billing is None:
        return
    address = _required_dict(billing, 'address', 'card.billing.address', errors)
    if address is None:
        return
    for key in ('line1', 'city', 'postal_code'):
        _required_str(address, key, f'card.billing.address.{key}', errors)
    country = _required_str(address, 'country', 'card.billing.address.country', errors)
    if country is not None and COUNTRY_PATTERN.fullmatch(country) is None:
        _add(errors, 'card.billing.address.country', 'COUNTRY_INVALID',
             'card.billing.address.country must be an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code')


def _validate_metadata(payload: dict, errors: list[ValidationError]) -> None:
    metadata = payload.get('metadata')
    if metadata is None:
        return
    if not isinstance(metadata, dict):
        _add(errors, 'metadata', 'METADATA_INVALID', 'metadata must be a flat object')
        return
    if len(metadata) > METADATA_MAX_KEYS:
        _add(errors, 'metadata', 'METADATA_TOO_MANY_KEYS', f'metadata may contain at most {METADATA_MAX_KEYS} keys')
    for key, value in metadata.items():
        path = _join('metadata', key)
        if not isinstance(key, str) or not isinstance(value, str):
            _add(errors, path, 'METADATA_INVALID', 'metadata keys and values must be strings')
            continue
        value = unicodedata.normalize('NFC', value)
        if len(value) > METADATA_MAX_VALUE_LENGTH:
            _add(errors, path, 'METADATA_VALUE_TOO_LONG', f'metadata values may be at most {METADATA_MAX_VALUE_LENGTH} characters')
        if _has_control(value, METADATA_ALLOWED_CONTROLS):
            _add(errors, path, 'CONTROL_CHARACTER', 'metadata value contains control characters')


def _validate_token_policy(payload: dict, errors: list[ValidationError]) -> None:
    policy = payload.get('token_policy')
    if policy is None:
        return
    if not isinstance(policy, dict):
        _add(errors, 'token_policy', 'INVALID_TYPE', 'token_policy must be an object')
        return
    single_use = policy.get('single_use')
    if single_use is not None and not isinstance(single_use, bool):
        _add(errors, 'token_policy.single_use', 'INVALID_TYPE', 'token_policy.single_use must be a boolean')
    ttl = policy.get('ttl_seconds')
    if ttl is None:
        return
    if isinstance(ttl, bool) or not isinstance(ttl, int):
        _add(errors, 'token_policy.ttl_seconds', 'INVALID_TYPE', 'token_policy.ttl_seconds must be an integer')
    elif not TTL_MIN_SECONDS <= ttl <= TTL_MAX_SECONDS:
        _add(errors, 'token_policy.ttl_seconds', 'TTL_OUT_OF_RANGE',
             f'token_policy.ttl_seconds must be between {TTL_MIN_SECONDS} and {TTL_MAX_SECONDS}')
